author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content:
WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️
The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required.
👉We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis.
All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio. We do not accept applications through Instagram.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists - JUMP Animation
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).
📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com
